verdict.rationale: Bulk issuance applies to a cap table platform like Carta, but the evidence pack shows no bulk upload, batch grant issuance, or historical-transaction import. The closest item is an API endpoint that creates a single draft option grant. That is a developer building block a user could script in a loop, not a documented bulk capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can upload or issue securities in bulk — a batch of grants or historical transactions — instead of entering them one at a time
